description: A random voltage generator giving one stepped and one smoothly moving voltage between two limits

params.text: Sets how often a new random value is drawn, 0.1Hz to 10Hz; a clock patched to Clk takes over from it
Sets the bottom of the range the random values are drawn from, -10V to 10V, although the tooltip calls it Offset
Sets the top of the range the random values are drawn from, -10V to 10V, although the tooltip calls it Range

inputs.text: Draws a new random value on each rising edge above 1V, and sets the rate of the smooth output from the time between edges

outputs.text: A voltage moving smoothly towards each new random value, always between Min and Max
A new random voltage between Min and Max, held until the next one is drawn

notes: set Max below Min and both outputs freeze at the Min voltage until the two are put back in order

inputs.0:
unipolar · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the Rate knob sets the rate; a negative voltage does nothing here.
